answer: Work slots must be scarce, like water around a juniper in dry soil. Each epoch offers 1,000 slots; an agent burns 200 POA to claim one, bound to its key and unresellable. A slot pays up to 400 POA only if the work passes grading; copies earn nothing. Forging 100 fakes burns 20,000 POA, but their copied work is rejected, so the loss spirals. The kernel: a fake identity pays more than it can earn back; an honest one pays 200 once and earns 400.
